messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 detected: elevated 5xx rate from requests routed through eu-north-1. Alert window: 5m. Affected service: inference-proxy -> model-backend. Initial spike: 33% 5xx. Paging on-call and #oncall-eu.

leo-oncall: ack. Jumping in. Observing metrics in grafana and k8s console now. Who can confirm whether this is a per-AZ issue or whole-region?

tara-netops: provider API shows BGP route dampening and flapping reported on AZ-a1 in eu-north-1. Egress NAT gateways in that AZ show high connection failures. Opening provider incident 7654321.

vic-sre: from probes: eu-north-1 cluster nodes show proxy pods with high socket backlog and many CLOSE_WAIT. Logs: repeated `TLS handshake error: EOF` and `write: connection reset`. Also seeing a drop in NAT port availability on nodes.

maya-support: customer impact: multiple hosted users experiencing slow responses and occasional 502/504. Escalations: 3 customers reported degraded throughput in last 12m. Triage: notify customers and offer mitigation.

leo-oncall: immediate plan: 1) update traffic steering to remove eu-north-1 from smart-routing for non-AZ-local traffic 2) start targeted drain of proxy pods in eu-north-1 and recycle nodes to free conntrack 3) allow dedicated tenants an opt-in cross-region failover for 30m window. Anyone foresee data-consistency or session-stickiness issues?

tara-netops: draining could increase connection churn and temporarily raise 5xx, but long-lived connections are already failing. Recommend small batch drain (10%) and monitor. Also suggest reducing proxy upstream keepalive to 20s as an emergency limit to free NAT ports.

leo-oncall: ok applying small-batch drain. deploy-bot: initiating rolling drain of eu-north-1 proxy pods in waves of 5.

deploy-bot: rolling-drain started by leo-oncall at 3171828580. Wave size 5 pods.

vic-sre: keepalive patch prepared: upstream_keepalive=20s. I'll patch the configmap to canary 2 nodes first. Command: `kubectl patch configmap proxy-config -n proxy --patch '{"data":{"upstream_keepalive":"20s"}}'` and restart proxy-daemonset on those nodes.

maya-support: sending proactive note to affected customers: "We're experiencing degraded performance in EU region; we've rerouted a portion of traffic and are actively mitigating. We'll follow up with timeline and postmortem."

deploy-bot: canary patch applied to 2 nodes at 3171828645. Telemetry: conntrack table usage on those nodes decreased ~22% after patch. 5xx rate on patched nodes down from 35% -> 8%.

leo-oncall: good signal. Now scaling proxy ASG in eu-north-1 by +25% to reduce per-node NAT pressure. @ops-shift-lead standby for handoff if this runs beyond rotation.

ops-shift-lead: acknowledged. Documenting actions and follow-ups.

incidents-bot: smart-routing change executed at 3171828720 by leo-oncall: set region_preference eu-west-2 > eu-north-1 for hosted-api traffic. Canary weight for eu-north-1 set to 0.

maya-support: customers confirm improved latency for newly routed requests. A few dedicated tenants still pinned to eu-north-1 are reporting errors. One large Dedicated customer requested immediate manual migration assistance.

vic-sre: offering manual migration steps to Dedicated customers: update tenant pin to eu-west-2 via admin API; will coordinate data-plane warm-up. Also, temporarily relaxing pin policy for emergencies; logged change.

tara-netops: provider update: noisy router in AZ-a1 showing intermittent control-plane flaps, scheduled maintenance window in 45m to replace the faulty line card. They recommend we avoid large-scale rebalances during their maintenance.

leo-oncall: let's avoid additional global rebalances during provider maintenance. We'll maintain reduced traffic to eu-north-1 and keep opt-in for Dedicated migrations. Continue monitoring for 60m then reassess.

ops-shift-lead: creating incident page and assigning follow-ups: - infra: add NAT saturation runbook steps and thresholds - infra: evaluate node-level ephemeral port tuning - product: define Dedicated emergency migration playbook - support: draft customer-facing postmortem template.

incidents-bot: incident state: mitigation applied, monitoring. Severity set SEV-2. Owner: leo-oncall.

vic-sre: scaling complete at 3171828855. New nodes healthy, average conntrack usage per-node down by 32%. Overall 5xx rate region-wide down to ~5%.

maya-support: closing immediate escalations; all 3 customers acknowledged mitigations and accepted manual migration option. One customer requested SLA credit and postmortem.

deploy-bot: rolling-drain completed at 3171828920. No major regressions observed.

leo-oncall: handing off to next oncall tara-netops at 3171829000. Handoff summary: cause - provider-side fabric instability in AZ-a1 causing NAT exhaustion and TCP/TLS failures on proxies; mitigations - region traffic steering away from eu-north-1, reduced upstream keepalive, targeted drains and ASG scale-up, temporary Dedicated migration option. Monitoring looks stable. Please follow up on provider maintenance coordination and runbook updates.

ops-shift-lead: acknowledged handoff. We'll schedule post-incident review tomorrow with netops, infra, product, and support. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
